title: Heat (H) — Mass and Temperature Dependency
notes: **Mass Dependency:** Heat absorbed/released (H) is directly proportional to mass (m): H ∝ m
**Temperature Dependency:** H is directly proportional to the change in temperature (Δθ): H ∝ Δθ, where Δθ = θ₂ − θ₁ (final − initial)
**Combined relation:** H ∝ m·Δθ → introducing specific heat capacity (s or c) as the constant of proportionality gives **H = m·c·Δθ**
